thread:
marie: quick heads-up — while running the v2 SDK smoke on the embed swap PR I hit a few oddities we should capture in a migration note.

marie: 1) alias fallback behavior: swapping alias from `embed-old` -> `rwd-embed-v2` sometimes returns a 200 with embedded vectors of the old dim (1536) but labels the model as the new alias. confused tests.

alex: hmm — that's probably from the alias-mapping cache not invalidating across the routing layer. did you repro locally consistently?

marie: yes, repro steps in the PR comment. quick gist: call -> POST /v2/embeddings {model: "rwd-embed-v2", input: "test"} sometimes returns length 1536 instead of 2048.

jyoti: thanks. can you paste minimal curl/ts snippet? we'll add to a troubleshooting bullet in the migration guide.

marie: pasted snippet in thread:
```
# curl example
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-v2","input":"hello"}'
```

sasha: also saw one SDK gotcha: v1 param `top_k` is now `candidate_count` in the v2 embeddings helper. if user still sends top_k the SDK warns but runtime silently ignores it. we should call that out.

alex: yeah we need a clear deprecation note: "param rename -> behavior; silent ignore vs error". prefer error for future, but we need to document current behavior and recommended code fix.

marie: proposal for docs change: short migration checklist with three bullets — model alias swap caveat + how to verify dims, param rename table, and a tiny smoke-test script to run post-swap.

jyoti: I'll author the checklist section, assign to docs PR: #4392. can someone add the smoke-test script to the repo? should be tiny node script.

sasha: I can add the node script. will include both JS and curl variants. will also add a note: run `redwoodctl flush-alias-cache --alias <alias>` for Dedicated/private customers.

marie: perfect. also add an example assertion: `assert(embedding.length === expected_dim)` and CLI to print dims.

docs-ci-bot: PR 4392 opened by jyoti: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4392 — lint checks running.

alex: pinging infra to verify alias cache TTL — @devops? (not in thread)

jyoti: small wording nit: use "model alias" consistently (not alias ID). will do a pass after initial commit.

marie: timeline: aim to merge migration note + script by EOD tomorrow. if we can't reproduce alias caching after cache flush, add rollback guidance for embed users.

sasha: ack. I'll also add a short snippet showing SDK change: 
```
// v1
client.embeddings.create({model: 'embed-old', top_k: 5, input: 'x'})
// v2
client.embeddings.create({model: 'rwd-embed-v2', candidate_count: 5, input: 'x'})
```

jyoti: good. will include a callout: "If you still rely on top_k in your app, migrate to candidate_count and run the smoke test across a canary subset."

marie: final ask: add a small note in the deprecation banner that highlights the embed-dim verification step. users should not assume identical dims after model swaps.

alex: I'll coordinate with product/comms for banner copy after docs PR merges.

marie: thanks everyone — assigning reviewers: @alex, @sasha. ping here when PR link is ready for review. :thumbsup:

sasha: PR link posted in thread and branch name is docs/embed-swap-checks. starting review now.

jyoti: pushing commit with wording + smoke tests. docs-ci-bot: please run kenv build.

docs-ci-bot: kenv build passed, link: https://ci.redwood.ai/kenv/4392/build-7

marie: merged after minor nits. leaving follow-up: add example in the SDK changelog to highlight `top_k -> candidate_count` mapping.

alex: will file a small follow-up ticket for the changelog entry.

marie: closing loop — great work. saved a weird customer surprise.
